decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's stated direction of trusted cross-channel communication, and the industry is growing, so performance likely meets aspirations and there is no reason to search for alternatives.

Mobile PDF signing supports the firm's move toward online contract signing, but as a narrow feature it may be folded into broader offerings if results fall short; available slack makes keeping it more likely.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the umbrella for the firm's integrated offering and is unlikely to fall below aspiration in a growing market.
The email-to-app delivery robot fits the goal of binding mobile communication, but it is a niche add-on with uncertain uptake; growth-driven slack lets the firm carry it for now.
The QR hardware token serves regulated customers needing strong authentication, but hardware margins and app-based alternatives may push results below aspiration, so the risk of dropping is moderate.
The payment security compliance suite addresses demanding regulatory requirements in a growing payments-security market, so results likely satisfy aspirations.
